notes: An endless path run to see how far you get before a pursuing threat catches you is Chase Runner, and lane-free is literally continuous lateral steering down a corridor, which is what a cramped hallway is. Survival is named second because the answers confirm genuine horror with monsters doing the chasing, but the game is distance in an endless corridor rather than outlasting a round, so it does not lead; it was a close call against Survival's interior-endless, which assumes a warren of rooms and dead ends instead of one hallway. Added chunk-modular for the stated endlessness and marker-distance because the answer makes distance the goal, on top of the preset's hazard-kill, obstacle-moving, and barrier-horizon, the last doubling as the dark-fog horizon a horror hallway wants. P6 is the genre-wide route and stays.
